title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Noodle Soup
description: A flavorful and refreshing soup made with Vietnamese lemongrass, dense noodles, and a variety of vegetables. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add lemongrass; cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add coconut milk and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add noodles and cook according to package instructions, about 8-10 minutes.
Stir in bean sprouts and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with lime juice and serve hot.
